verdict.rationale: Nitrokey is a hardware security key vendor with an official CLI (nitropy) and a Python SDK, so shipping an official MCP server is plausible and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint. The CLI, the SDK, and failed probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI are not MCP support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
